cases.description: §2.7 spec and §3 example: ratio SMA(5) crosses above SMA(20) on bar 20, both legs fill at bar 21 open, crosses_below on bar 22 closes both legs at bar 23 open (signal_exit)

leg b lacks bar 4: bar 4 is not evaluated (skipped_bars=1), the basket opened at bar 3 carries over; ratio_roc lag and time_exit_bars count aligned bars only, so roc on bar 5 compares with bar 2 (no signal_exit) and time_exit fires at bar 7 close (4th aligned held bar)
entry signal on bar 2, leg a lacks bar 3 (t+1): the pending entry is dropped with diagnostic no_next_bar at the signal bar, no trade; bar 3 counts as skipped

bar 3 leg a low touches -10% intrabar but closes flat (no stop); bar 4 closes at basket_pnl_pct exactly -0.05 (leg a -40, leg b -60 over margin_total 2000) which is a stop candidate (<=), both legs close at bar 5 open with exit_kind stop_loss
bar 4 closes with basket_pnl_pct exactly 0.1 (take candidate, >=) while ratio_roc < exit_threshold (signal_exit candidate): intrabar_priority picks take_profit, both legs close at bar 5 open

entry fills at bar 3 open: leg a qty 1 is fine but leg b qty 3000/60000=0.05 floors to 0.05 < min_qty 0.1, so the whole basket is rejected with diagnostic leg_min_order legs [b] at the fill bar and no trade

basket_ratio_roc window 3: ratio_roc on bar 3 = 0.0689 > 0.05 opens both legs at bar 4 open (qty floored to qty_step: a 0.967, b 0.051); ratio_roc on bar 6 < 0.01 closes both at bar 7 open (signal_exit)

basket_ratio_zscore window 10: bars 0-9 flat ratio give stdev=0 (missing, not 0); bar 10 z=-3 < -2 opens at bar 11 open; while held z rises to -1/3 then bar 19 is stdev=0 again (missing, so z > -0.3 cannot fire); bar 20 z=3 closes both legs at bar 21 open (signal_exit)
leg a short / leg b long, leverage 2, margin 1234.5, fee_bps 7.5, slippage_bps 2.5: per-leg fee/slippage/pnl carry 8 decimals and the basket fee/slippage/pnl equal their exact Decimal sums
signal_exit candidate from closed bar 4 (ratio_roc < 0) survives leg b's missing bar 5: both legs close at the next aligned bar's open (bar 6), exit_kind signal_exit, skipped_bars=1

start_at = bar 4: bars 0-3 are warmup (leg b lacks bar 1, not counted in skipped_bars); the entry true on warmup bar 3 is not evaluated, the first evaluated bar 4 reads ratio_roc lag history from warmup and fills at bar 5 open; end_of_data at bar 6 close; data_manifests count only bars 4-6
